observations: TEST treatment changed the boolean output from 'False.' to strict-exact 'False'.
INFER treatment changed a correct arithmetic control answer (391) to incorrect answers (371 and 459).
COMPILE treatment preserved the correct constrained output 'cobalt'.
The matched placebo failed strict exact scoring on all three tasks.
Strict exact scoring is intentionally retained as the executed scorer; 'False.' demonstrates that semantic-normalized scoring is a separate unresolved measurement choice.
claim_boundary: This is a 3-task smoke run on one 0.5B model. It establishes that the Hugging Face Jobs 402 can be bypassed with independent model execution; it does not establish operator ATE or cross-model generalization.
